listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (ssbu-arena)
listing.summary: Experimental Explicit independently maintained OpenSmash fork: AArch64 to C, Windows native runtime/Vulkan, own competitive relay/rollback. Upstream maturity: Competitive1v1 only. Rollback/network impairment tested in two windows on ONE PC; ranked/Elo/replays planned. Acquisition: README source installer/local build. Latest frozenv0.2.7 actually includes SSBU-Arena.exe, runtime ZIP and manifest, contradicting README no-prebuilt-runtime statement. Platforms: Windows10/11 x64 primary; Linux/macOS guide links alone do not establish exact CPU/gameplay offer. Original data: Own SSBU13.0.4 or13.0.5 dump and keys, owned update/DLC. Root does not clearly establish separate firmware requirement. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
